repos_data.description: The definitive MCP server for Scrivener — connect your novels, screenplays, and manuscripts to Claude, ChatGPT, and any AI assistant. 53 tools: document management, writing analysis, content enhancement, offline semantic search, and character/plot tracking.
给网文作者的本地章节体检：16 个工具做句式/情感/风格基线分析，24MB 模型本地跑、零 API 花费、不上传正文。DSH / DeepSeek Harness 插件。Local novel-writing assistant for DSH: on-device sentence/emotion/style-baseline analysis, zero token cost.
